notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.10103
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue some users had applying customizations
 Fixed an issue where some slimes would get stuck.
 Fixed a hysterical issue where the !jockey command would create some... interesting movement that required us to consult a theorical physicist.

notes.notes:

Debug objects removed from GoSplat scene
Material transparency adjusted.
